Life at Tailor

Why you’ll love working here

Growth & development

Over half of our roles are filled by promoting our own team members.

50-50

50% of our team across all departments are women and 50% are men.

Team bonding

Each quarter, every team has a budget to celebrate and connect.

Unlimited vacation days

As simple as that.

Parents friendly

We have a supportive and flexible environment for moms and dads.

Side-hustle support

As part of our vision, we encourage and support team members’ side projects.

make something valuable

Our work impacts real people’s lives

Every person who starts a business is taking a chance on themselves. We help make that step feel possible.

How we do things at Tailor

Our values are our DNA

They’re not some high and mighty ideals; they’re how we get things done around here, and how we live and breathe Tailor every day

Trust

We extend trust by default and act with full transparency.

Results

We obsess over outcomes — impact, not activity.

Beautiful

Whatever we build, we build it beautifully — inside and out.

Try & Fail

We move fast, take big swings, and learn from every miss.

Ranked among Israel’s best hi-tech companies to work for 2023 and 2024

The community of business owners

Our commitment to business owners is our mission and we put our money where our mouth is. We’re actively empowering the small business community through many initiatives and projects

Suppliers preference

We’re committed to prioritizing small business suppliers wherever we can, giving them opportunities to grow and succeed alongside us.

Small business fairs

We regularly organize fairs where small businesses can showcase their products. Our team members’ friends and family get to discover and purchase unique gifts, while business owners gain sales and exposure.
